policy.predict_contract: async_predict(native_text, profile_id) -> utterance.Prediction(duration_seconds, processed_model_token_count); caller must adapt DP session output explicitly to this exact frozen type.
policy.delivery: Existing registry/router validate frozen DeliverySpec including forged/stale fields. Optional resolver is called once before prediction and must return validated ResolvedDelivery with server-owned profile ID and registered scalar labels. Selection is constant across all groups. No native emotion capabilities are invented.
context_order: entire original request including paragraphs if both source/native hard envelope fits and model predicts <=28 seconds and <=512 processed tokens
paragraph contexts when whole request rejected
longest adjacent clause prefixes using injected predictions in descending endpoint order
bounded lexical/currency/code/quote units and balanced source-preserving decomposition
policy.search: No duration/token monotonicity or length-based model estimate assumed. Per-request cache uses normalized text and fixed resolved profile. Descending clause search can spend several rejected probes; hard cap is 64 actual predictor calls.
policy.native_30_second_hard_guard: Unchanged and still mandatory in renderer. Planner prediction is not actual duration.
policy.coverage: Every group uses exact contiguous original Python-character start/end offsets including leading/trailing whitespace. Native normalized copy is separate. Text words/order/punctuation and the reply length are not edited.
policy.budget_exhaustion: Remaining source is covered by conservative bounded_fallback groups with prediction=None, prediction_budget_exhausted reason, and resource_envelope_verified=False. No numeric estimate fabricated.
policy.fail_closed: Predictor exceptions, cancellation and malformed prediction abort the entire plan without returning partial/fallback success. Impossible one-character resource violations are explicit indivisible_resource_limit groups with verified=False; caller must not interpret them as resource-safe.

limitations: Injected deterministic predictions only. Real DP session accuracy, normalized-token parity, actual native duration, rendering seam, playback/ACK behavior, audio naturalness, speaker identity and emotional suitability remain parent-owned and unverified here.
resource_envelope_verified means injected prediction is within the planning envelope, not measured synthesis success. Budget fallback is bounded text, not verified duration or tokens.

Sentence/quote/abbreviation boundaries are conservative heuristics, not a full multilingual parser. Lowercase attribution is retained; uppercase-name attributions, unmatched/nested quotes, unusual abbreviations, malformed code, and pathological long identifiers may still split.
Code/quotes/currency/URLs/identifiers are preserved where feasible; oversized protected/lexical units eventually require source-character splitting to respect hard limits.
Normalizer is trusted injected behavior and must be deterministic, bounded, and compatible with unchanged native guard rules. Original source remains exact even when normalized text differs.
No production/service/native/git/download operation performed. This is not deployment or acceptance of natural speech.
